| 1 | MAJOR | Delta introduces control dependencies (`core/backlog.py`, `scripts/dev/gate2_completion_check.py`) but leaves `contracts.files`/`affected_files` unchanged, so the AC-3 anti-bypass control has no declared file/evidence row in the same delta (guardrail: matching rows must update together). | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 design and tests. |
| 2 | MINOR | `coverage` has no row for AC-2's tests (`test_shared_selector_used_for_reviews`, `test_architect_review_uses_shared_selector`) that `test_matrix` lists — coverage/test_matrix diverge on a new AC. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 design and tests. |
| 3 | MINOR | `functional_spec.traceability`/`requirements` contain only FR-1/FR-2; AC-2 (shared deterministic helper with tests covering both callers) maps to no requirement or traceability row. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 design and tests. |
| 4 | MINOR | Delta `observability` rows emit only `skipped_closed=<n>`; no emitted signal is specified for the mtime fallback, which AC-3 requires to be explicit and observable. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 design and tests. |
| 5 | MINOR | `functional_spec.dependencies` (only `BI-PF-1243`) is not synced with the expanded `design_pack.dependencies` in the same delta. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 design and tests. |
| 6 | NIT | AC-2 architect-review tests are named and placed in `test_fix_guard.py` with no architect-review test file declared in `contracts.files`. | PENDING | (no response yet) |
| 7 | NIT | `functional_spec.data_lifecycle` states "No runtime data" while the selector reads on-disk review evidence files. | PENDING | (no response yet) |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta resolves several prior findings (contradicting `risks` tamper row removed, observability wording unified, `adapter` now names `core/backlog.py`, AC-1 coverage row synced).
  Verdict: sound design direction; top residual risks are the undeclared file rows for the close-guard control dependency and incomplete AC-2 traceability/coverage.
